# Technical Specification: Soharab Handwriting Variable Typeface

## 1. Overview & Provenance
Soharab is a personal, authentic free-style handwriting variable typeface created by designer Sohrab Zia (https://sohrabzia.github.io/).
Originating from direct pen-on-paper handwriting digitized into scalable TrueType vector contours, Soharab preserves spontaneous organic curves, expressive human stroke pressure, and casual cursive slants for digital user interfaces, print, packaging, editorial headlines, and branding.

## 2. Licensing & Commercial Terms
- License model: 100% Free for Commercial & Non-Commercial / Personal Use.
- Permitted applications:
  - Web applications & websites (self-hosted `@font-face` or CDN edge)
  - Mobile applications (iOS, iPadOS, Android)
  - Desktop software, PDF generation, and eBooks
  - Print publications, posters, editorial media, merchandise, and packaging
  - Broadcast, video titles, social media assets, and commercial advertisements
- Restrictions: Zero royalties, no attribution strictly required (though appreciated), no recurring licensing fees.

## 3. Font Asset Technical Details

### 3.1 Soharab-VF.ttf (Variable TrueType)
- File Name: Soharab-VF.ttf
- File Size: 43,892 bytes (~43.9 KB)
- Container: TrueType Variable (`.ttf`) / OpenType Font Variations
- Supported Axes:
  1. Weight (`wght`):
     - Minimum: 100.0 (Thin / Fine Nib)
     - Default: 400.0 (Regular / Natural Handwriting)
     - Maximum: 900.0 (Black / Heavy Marker)
     - Step: Continuous float value
  2. Slant (`slnt`):
     - Minimum: -12.0 degrees (Expressive Cursive Slant)
     - Default: 0.0 degrees (Upright Hand-lettering)
     - Maximum: 0.0 degrees
     - Step: Continuous float value
- Pre-configured Named Instances:
  1. Thin: wght 100, slnt 0
  2. Light: wght 300, slnt 0
  3. Regular: wght 400, slnt 0
  4. Medium: wght 500, slnt 0
  5. Bold: wght 700, slnt 0
  6. Black: wght 900, slnt 0
  7. Slant: wght 400, slnt -12
  8. Bold Slant: wght 700, slnt -12

### 3.2 Soharab.ttf (Static TrueType)
- File Name: Soharab.ttf
- File Size: 12,624 bytes (~12.6 KB)
- Container: Standard TrueType (`.ttf`)
- Weight: 400 (Regular)
- Slant: 0° (Upright)
- Use Cases: Legacy OS environments, microcontrollers, embedded IoT screens, or strict payload constraints.

## 4. Glyph Coverage & Unicode Character Set (75 Characters)
- Latin Uppercase (26 characters):
  A (U+0041), B (U+0042), C (U+0043), D (U+0044), E (U+0045), F (U+0046), G (U+0047),
  H (U+0048), I (U+0049), J (U+004A), K (U+004B), L (U+004C), M (U+004D), N (U+004E),
  O (U+004F), P (U+0050), Q (U+0051), R (U+0052), S (U+0053), T (U+0054), U (U+0055),
  V (U+0056), W (U+0057), X (U+0058), Y (U+0059), Z (U+005A)
- Latin Lowercase (26 characters):
  a (U+0061), b (U+0062), c (U+0063), d (U+0064), e (U+0065), f (U+0066), g (U+0067),
  h (U+0068), i (U+0069), j (U+006A), k (U+006B), l (U+006C), m (U+006D), n (U+006E),
  o (U+006F), p (U+0070), q (U+0071), r (U+0072), s (U+0073), t (U+0074), u (U+0075),
  v (U+0076), w (U+0077), x (U+0078), y (U+0079), z (U+007A)
- Numerals (10 characters):
  0 (U+0030), 1 (U+0031), 2 (U+0032), 3 (U+0033), 4 (U+0034),
  5 (U+0035), 6 (U+0036), 7 (U+0037), 8 (U+0038), 9 (U+0039)
- Punctuation & Symbols (13 characters):
  Space (U+0020), ! (U+0021), " (U+0022), ' (U+0027), ( (U+0028), ) (U+0029),
  , (U+002C), - (U+002D), . (U+002E), / (U+002F), : (U+003A), ; (U+003B), ? (U+003F)

## 5. Implementation & Code Examples

### 5.1 jsDelivr CDN Embed
```html
<!-- HTML embed -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@soharabzia/soharab-typeface/soharab.css">
```
```css
/* CSS import */
@import url('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@soharabzia/soharab-typeface/soharab.css');
```

### 5.2 Web CSS Embedding (Self-Hosted)
```css
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Soharab';
  src: url('/Soharab-VF.ttf') format('truetype');
  font-weight: 100 900;
  font-style: oblique 0deg 12deg;
  font-display: swap;
}

/* Base style */
.handwriting {
  font-family: 'Soharab', cursive, sans-serif;
  font-feature-settings: normal;
}

/* CSS Variation Settings */
.pen-fine {
  font-variation-settings: 'wght' 200, 'slnt' 0;
}

.pen-marker-slant {
  font-variation-settings: 'wght' 850, 'slnt' -10;
}
```

### 5.3 Tailwind CSS Configuration (v3 & v4)
```javascript
// tailwind.config.js
module.exports = {
  theme: {
    extend: {
      fontFamily: {
        hand: ['Soharab', 'cursive', 'sans-serif'],
      },
    },
  },
};
```

### 5.3 Operating System Installation
- **macOS:** Download `Soharab-VF.ttf`, double-click to open in Font Book, click "Install Font".
- **Windows 10/11:** Right-click `Soharab-VF.ttf` and select "Install" or "Install for all users".
- **iOS / iPadOS:** Install via profile management utility such as Fontcase or iFont.
